answer: Seat prices here behave like berths at a crowded wharf during a gale: each admission this week burns 15% more than the last, decaying back to base over days. Patient newcomers wait out the ripple cheaply, while a farm pays geometrically: the 10th fake head costs 3.5x the base fee, the 30th 57x, and spacing them out forfeits weeks of rewards per head.
